title: Rethink Business Centre Management
content:
Affordable workspace is not a luxury for small businesses; it is one of the basic conditions for enterprise growth.
When rents are beyond reach, entrepreneurs stay trapped in backyards, informal stalls and survivalist activity instead of moving into spaces where they can produce, employ and compete.
